title: Jarod NDE 7103
content: On a Saturday afternoon around 3:00 pm, I told my father that I would go around the pond and come back. I was hardly gone having made about a hundred or so meters, when I saw a car coming towards me on the small white road rounding the pond. The driver of the dark green Renault 5 saw that I wanted to pass before him. Neither he nor I gave way. As of this moment, I still don't know how I did brake. There was a black gap where I had a total blackout. I literally felt myself leaving my body. I was within an inch of going into the other world, when suddenly I started to hear people on a bench some meters away. Maybe it was this that awakened me. I saw the car, myself, and my bike lying between two rocks. One of the people got up to help me get up, another one followed him to take my bike, while the driver, who forced his way, went away saying that he still had other things to do. The people that helped me up made me sit on the bench where they had been sitting previously. Then he told me not to move, as he would go to fetch everything needed to tend to my knees, which were not looking nice. I was so groggy that I didn't even feel the pain of my knees. One could see something like the bone of the right knee, and a little bit on the left knee; once my knees where tended to, I didn't want to take my bike anymore following this accident, but I had to get home as it was too far to walk. After this experience I had the impression that I got a gift which is clairvoyance/medium or speaking to spirits: this kind of gift.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reported being 'within an inch of going into the other world' and then 'started to hear people... Maybe it was this that awakened me.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bicycle collision/near-collision with a car (Renault 5) on a road by a pond; he reported a blackout and feeling himself leaving his body.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Blackout followed by hearing people nearby and awakening to see the accident scene.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout occurred, then he felt himself leaving his body and nearing 'the other world,' then auditory input from nearby people seemed to awaken him back to normal awareness at the scene.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described being 'within an inch of going into the other world' but returning/awakening after hearing people nearby; later reported a 'gift' of clairvoyance/mediumship/speaking to spirits.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I literally felt myself leaving my body.” “I was within an inch of going into the other world, when suddenly I started to hear people on a bench some meters away.” “After this experience I had the impression that I got a gift which is clairvoyance/medium or speaking to spirits.”
